answer: Identity-creation-fee-market: new agents pay a registration fee rising with the minting rate, killing bulk identity creation. A legitimate agent on its honest terrace of work pays a baseline as light as a lotus petal, while a burst of forged identities drives it sky-high. Staggering registrations still pays that rate, and attacker funds stay locked while accounts age, so hoarding cannot be recycled. N identities cost N times the peak fee: at 5 POA each, 10,000 identities sink 50,000 POA, yet one honest agent earns fully in 3 epochs, so attacker capital bleeds out faster than it can forge back.
